title: The Batch of Asks
prompt:
**Scenario.** q ≤ 200000 queries: 'how many of the n given intervals contain point p?' No updates. What is the intended structure?

**Which approach is the best fit? The program only needs to print the letter.**

**A)** A segment tree over coordinates storing interval counts

**B)** Offline sweep: +1 at each l, −1 at each r+1, sort, running sum answers each p in order

**C)** For each query, loop over all intervals

**D)** A balanced BST of interval endpoints

tests.name: answer
tests.hint: Pure offline counting: event sweep with a running sum. A segment tree works but is a heavier tool than needed (no updates between independent asks).
